title: What are keys in React and why are they important?
description: Understand the purpose of keys in React lists.

data.text: **Question:** What are keys in React and why are they important?
Keys are special string attributes that help React identify which items in a list have changed, been added, or been removed. They improve rendering performance and help maintain component state.

**Purpose of Keys:**
- Help React identify which elements changed
- Improve reconciliation efficiency
- Preserve component state across re-renders
- Enable proper diffing algorithm
- Prevent unnecessary re-renders

**Key Requirements:**
- Must be unique among siblings
- Should be stable (don't use index if list changes)
- Should be predictable
- Typically use unique IDs from data
- Avoid using array index as key for dynamic lists

**When Keys Matter:**
- Rendering lists of elements
- Adding/removing/reordering items
- Preserving input state in list items
- Animating list items
- Any dynamic list manipulation
